description: GPT-4o mini is OpenAI's most cost-efficient small model. It is multimodal (text and vision) and has higher intelligence than GPT-3.5 Turbo while being significantly cheaper. Designed for lightweight tasks and high-volume applications.

outOfScope: Complex multi-step reasoning requiring GPT-4o capabilities

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse mixture of licensed data, data created by human trainers, and publicly available data. Specific training data composition is proprietary.

trainingProcedure: Trained using similar techniques to GPT-4o with RLHF. Optimized for efficiency and cost-effectiveness while maintaining strong performance.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Scores 82% on MMLU, outperforming GPT-3.5 Turbo. Provides strong performance on text and vision tasks at a fraction of GPT-4o's cost.

knownLimitations: Less capable than GPT-4o on complex reasoning tasks
May generate incorrect or misleading information
Knowledge limited to training data cutoff date
Can exhibit biases present in training data

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: OpenAI has implemented safety mitigations but the model may still exhibit biases from training data.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Built-in content filtering and usage policies enforcement. Includes the same safety features as GPT-4o.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: Data sent to the API may be used to improve the model unless opted out.
